name: Taskbuilder – Project Management & Task Management Tool With Kanban Board
author: taskbuilder

sections.description:
Taskbuilder simplifies project management and task management with powerful features like a visual kanban board, custom fields, duplicate projects, calendar view, and due date reminders. It includes user groups, recurring tasks, overdue notifications, a built-in time tracker, Gantt charts, checklists, and email piping. With detailed dashboards and reporting, Taskbuilder helps teams stay organized and productive. It also integrates seamlessly with BuddyPress, WooCommerce, supportcandy for extended functionality.

Shortcodes :

Taskbuilder lets you bring project management directly to your website’s frontend. Use the available shortcodes to create dedicated project management pages:

[wppm_projects] - Manage projects from front-end.
[wppm_tasks] - Manage tasks from front-end.
[wppm_dashboard] - Access dashboard from front-end.
[wppm_my_tasks] - To display tasks assigned to the current user on the frontend.
[wppm_tasks_calendar] - Use Calendar on front-end(pro feature).
[wppm_tasks project ="insert project name here"]- If you want to display only selected project's task on page, you can add attribute as project name to tasks shortcode. It will only display tasks of selected project.
[wppm_public_projects_tasks] = Display public project's tasks from frontend.
[wppm_gantt_chart project ="insert project name here"]- You can access Gantt Chart from frontend. You have to give project name as parameter in shortcode (pro feature).
[wppm_group_projects] = To display BuddyPress group-associated projects on any frontend page. Supports filtering by Group ID [wppm_group_projects group_id="15"] or Group Name/Slug [wppm_group_projects group="group-name"] (pro feature).
[wppm_group_tasks] =  Display tasks associated with BuddyPress groups on any frontend page. Supports filtering by Group ID [wppm_group_tasks group_id="15"]` or Group Name/Slug `[wppm_group_tasks group="group-name"](pro feature)`.

`
Create a centralized workspace where your team can access projects, manage tasks, and track their work without navigating the WordPress administration area.
You can also combine multiple shortcodes on a single page to create a centralized project management workspace.

🌟 Top Features

  • Modern Dashboard: Get a quick overview of projects, tasks, and team workload in one centralized place.
  • Project Management: Create and organize projects, manage project members, monitor progress, and keep all project information in one place.
  • Powerful Task Management: Create tasks, assign team members, set priorities, manage deadlines, and track task progress.
  • Kanban Board: Visualize your workflow with an intuitive Kanban board. Organize tasks by status and move them through your workflow.
  • My Tasks: Give team members a dedicated view of their tasks, helping them focus on their responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Quick Edit: Update task and project information quickly without navigating through multiple screens.
  • Task Overview & Collaboration: Keep task discussions, comments, attachments, and change history together so everyone stays informed.
  • Project Overview: Get a clear picture of project progress, completed tasks, active tasks, and overdue work.
  • Unlimited co-workers: There is no limit to add co-workers. You can create any number of co-workers so that you can divide your workload. You can use wordpress’s registered users as co-workers(manager, co-workers) or client.
  • Free Subtasks: Create and manage subtasks for better task organization, and convert subtasks into standalone tasks — completely free.
  • Client Access Mode: Add users with a client role to projects and tasks with controlled access.
  • Team Collaboration: Work together with your team in real time.
  • Task Comment Mentions: Mention team members directly in task comments using @mentions to notify and collaborate with the right people.
  • Ajax functionality: Almost every functionality is Ajax based so that its operational speed is at its best.
  • Manage Projects & Tasks From Front-end: There is no need to pay anything for manage projects and tasks from front-end.
  • Checklist: Break big tasks into small ones, check things off the list, and watch that status bar go to 100% complete.
  • File Attachments: Files can attached in comments.
  • Responsive Design: It is designed to work on any possbile screen size so that you can operate anytime, anywhere. It is recommended to use full-width template for Project and Task page so that it will work smoothly.
  • Kanban Board: Cards represent your tasks and have everything you need to get the job done. As you make progress, drag cards from list to list so that everyone knows the status of the task at hand.
  • List View: You can manage tasks and project on list view.
  • Filter: You can filter task and projects by Title,Project name, Status, Category, Priority,User Names.
  • Advanced Filters: Quickly find the tasks you need using advanced filters such as Created By, Assigned User, Priority, Start Date, and End Date.
  • Email Notifications: Customizable email notification templates available for you to customize as per your requirement. You can make use of macro tags for task & projects specific information which gets replaced dynamically.
  • Global Notifications: Get notified when you are mentioned in a task comment or assigned a task.
  • Custom Statuses: You can create unlimited custom statuses for projects and tasks.
  • Custom Priorities: You can create unlimited custom priorities for tasks.
  • Custom Categories: You can create unlimited custom categories for projects.
  • Appearance Setting: Customizable Appearance to match up with your theme.
  • Shortcode Attribute: Display selected project’s task on frontend. If you want to display only selected project’s task on page, you can add attribute as project name to tasks shortcode. It will only display tasks of selected project.For ex- add shortcode [wppm_tasks project =”insert project name here”] on page. It will only shows tasks of project which you added as a project parameter in task’s shortcode.
  • Archive Tasks and Projects: Keep your workspace organized by archiving completed or inactive tasks and projects instead of permanently deleting them.

🙌 After reading this feature list, you can probably imagine Taskbuilder is the most advanced and powerful task & project management plugin in the market. Give Taskbuilder a try.

🚀 Why Choose Taskbuilder?
* Built for WordPress: Manage projects and tasks directly from your own WordPress website.
* Complete Project Workflow: Organize projects, create tasks, assign team members, and track completion.
* Visual Task Management: Use Kanban boards and task lists to manage work your way.
* Team-Focused: Give project members clear responsibilities and visibility into their work.
* Flexible Access: Manage project roles and permissions according to your team’s needs.
* Frontend & Backend Management: Let users work with projects and tasks through dedicated frontend pages using shortcodes.
* Extendable: Add more capabilities with Taskbuilder premium add-ons.
* Take control of your projects without moving your team’s workflow to another platform.

🔌 Extend Taskbuilder With Premium Add-ons :

Need more advanced project management capabilities? Extend Taskbuilder with premium add-ons.
* Calender – Get daily, weekly, or monthly view of task timelines with drag and drop feature. Filter them by Title,Project name, Status, Category, Priority,User Names if necessary.
* Email Piping – Email piping allows users to create tasks directly from their email inboxes. This will save a lot of time to visit your website every time, log in to their account, and then create a new task.
* Custom Fields – You can add Custom Field to the tasks and for projects. There are 5 types of custom fields you can create. i.e. Text, Number, Date, Dropdown, File Upload.
* Time Tracker – Time tracker tracks the exact time you spent on your tasks. Timer with start, stop feature for every task.
* Gantt Chart – Gantt Chart add-on effectively time manage your tasks and visualize upcoming deadlines for any project. Projects planners also use Gantt charts to maintain a bird’s eye view of projects.
* Duplicate Project – Duplicate Project add-on allows you to clone existing project and you will get same project with(tasks+checklists).
* Report – Report add-on allows you to create detail project progress reports for any project and customize which data should be shown in the report. You can then download report in PDF or CSV format.
* Buddypress – Buddypress Integration add-on allows you to create and manage projects,tasks in buddypress group on your own WordPress site.
* WooCommerce – WooCommerce Integration add-on automatically create task after order received. You can set order details in task description.
* Due Date Reminder – Due date reminder are super helpful for keeping your team on track to hit deadlines. Email notification will send to customer before due date of task.
* Usergroup – Using usergroup add-on you can assign group of users to project and those group assign to project can be assign to tasks of project.
* Recurrent Task – Recurrent Tasks add-on allow administrators to effortlessly schedule recurring tasks for routine tasks The system automatically generates these tasks at the defined times, providing a streamlined approach to essential and repetitive processes. With versatile recurrence periods, customizable scheduling options, and the ability to set start and end dates.
* Overdue Notifier – Overdue Notifier is a add-on that automatically sends email notifications when a task’s due date has passed and the task is not yet completed.
* SupportCandy– SupportCandy integration automatically creates a Taskbuilder task when a new SupportCandy ticket is created, and adds private notes to the ticket when the task is created and completed.

👨‍💻 DOCUMENTATION AND SUPPORT

  • For documentation and tutorials go to our Help
  • If you have any more questions, visit our Support

Available Translations :

Available in below languages.

If you are a translator, you can get free access to all premium add-ons for a year in exchange for translating them into your language if it is not available already. We will renew the Premium subscription next year if you continue contributing to the translation. If interested, don’t hesitate to contact us via our support page.
sections.installation:
This plugin is almost plug and play!

From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for “Taskbuilder”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation (ZIP file)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Choose the Taskbuilder ZIP file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin.

You can also extract the ZIP file and upload the taskbuilder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, then activate it from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Q. Why can’t I assign a user to a task?

Tasks can only be assigned to members of the task’s project. Open the project, add the user to its Users list, then assign the task.

Q. Who can create projects?

A. Only Admin’s can create projects and edit them.

Q. Who can create tasks, checklist, comments?

A. Admins and every co-workers from a project can create these.

Q. Can every member see every project?

A. Only admins (administrator) can see all of them. Other user roles can only see their assigned projects.

Q. Can the plugin be extended?

A. Sure, lots of actions and filters are added by default and will add more of them.

description:
Taskbuilder simplifies project management and task management with powerful features like a visual kanban board, custom fields, duplicate projects, calendar view, and due date reminders. It includes user groups, recurring tasks, overdue notifications, a built-in time tracker, Gantt charts, checklists, and email piping. With detailed dashboards and reporting, Taskbuilder helps teams stay organized and productive. It also integrates seamlessly with BuddyPress, WooCommerce, supportcandy for extended functionality.

Shortcodes :

Taskbuilder lets you bring project management directly to your website’s frontend. Use the available shortcodes to create dedicated project management pages:

[wppm_projects] - Manage projects from front-end.
[wppm_tasks] - Manage tasks from front-end.
[wppm_dashboard] - Access dashboard from front-end.
[wppm_my_tasks] - To display tasks assigned to the current user on the frontend.
[wppm_tasks_calendar] - Use Calendar on front-end(pro feature).
[wppm_tasks project ="insert project name here"]- If you want to display only selected project's task on page, you can add attribute as project name to tasks shortcode. It will only display tasks of selected project.
[wppm_public_projects_tasks] = Display public project's tasks from frontend.
[wppm_gantt_chart project ="insert project name here"]- You can access Gantt Chart from frontend. You have to give project name as parameter in shortcode (pro feature).
[wppm_group_projects] = To display BuddyPress group-associated projects on any frontend page. Supports filtering by Group ID [wppm_group_projects group_id="15"] or Group Name/Slug [wppm_group_projects group="group-name"] (pro feature).
[wppm_group_tasks] =  Display tasks associated with BuddyPress groups on any frontend page. Supports filtering by Group ID [wppm_group_tasks group_id="15"]` or Group Name/Slug `[wppm_group_tasks group="group-name"](pro feature)`.

`
Create a centralized workspace where your team can access projects, manage tasks, and track their work without navigating the WordPress administration area.
You can also combine multiple shortcodes on a single page to create a centralized project management workspace.

🌟 Top Features

  • Modern Dashboard: Get a quick overview of projects, tasks, and team workload in one centralized place.
  • Project Management: Create and organize projects, manage project members, monitor progress, and keep all project information in one place.
  • Powerful Task Management: Create tasks, assign team members, set priorities, manage deadlines, and track task progress.
  • Kanban Board: Visualize your workflow with an intuitive Kanban board. Organize tasks by status and move them through your workflow.
  • My Tasks: Give team members a dedicated view of their tasks, helping them focus on their responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Quick Edit: Update task and project information quickly without navigating through multiple screens.
  • Task Overview & Collaboration: Keep task discussions, comments, attachments, and change history together so everyone stays informed.
  • Project Overview: Get a clear picture of project progress, completed tasks, active tasks, and overdue work.
  • Unlimited co-workers: There is no limit to add co-workers. You can create any number of co-workers so that you can divide your workload. You can use wordpress’s registered users as co-workers(manager, co-workers) or client.
  • Free Subtasks: Create and manage subtasks for better task organization, and convert subtasks into standalone tasks — completely free.
  • Client Access Mode: Add users with a client role to projects and tasks with controlled access.
  • Team Collaboration: Work together with your team in real time.
  • Task Comment Mentions: Mention team members directly in task comments using @mentions to notify and collaborate with the right people.
  • Ajax functionality: Almost every functionality is Ajax based so that its operational speed is at its best.
  • Manage Projects & Tasks From Front-end: There is no need to pay anything for manage projects and tasks from front-end.
  • Checklist: Break big tasks into small ones, check things off the list, and watch that status bar go to 100% complete.
  • File Attachments: Files can attached in comments.
  • Responsive Design: It is designed to work on any possbile screen size so that you can operate anytime, anywhere. It is recommended to use full-width template for Project and Task page so that it will work smoothly.
  • Kanban Board: Cards represent your tasks and have everything you need to get the job done. As you make progress, drag cards from list to list so that everyone knows the status of the task at hand.
  • List View: You can manage tasks and project on list view.
  • Filter: You can filter task and projects by Title,Project name, Status, Category, Priority,User Names.
  • Advanced Filters: Quickly find the tasks you need using advanced filters such as Created By, Assigned User, Priority, Start Date, and End Date.
  • Email Notifications: Customizable email notification templates available for you to customize as per your requirement. You can make use of macro tags for task & projects specific information which gets replaced dynamically.
  • Global Notifications: Get notified when you are mentioned in a task comment or assigned a task.
  • Custom Statuses: You can create unlimited custom statuses for projects and tasks.
  • Custom Priorities: You can create unlimited custom priorities for tasks.
  • Custom Categories: You can create unlimited custom categories for projects.
  • Appearance Setting: Customizable Appearance to match up with your theme.
  • Shortcode Attribute: Display selected project’s task on frontend. If you want to display only selected project’s task on page, you can add attribute as project name to tasks shortcode. It will only display tasks of selected project.For ex- add shortcode [wppm_tasks project =”insert project name here”] on page. It will only shows tasks of project which you added as a project parameter in task’s shortcode.
  • Archive Tasks and Projects: Keep your workspace organized by archiving completed or inactive tasks and projects instead of permanently deleting them.

🙌 After reading this feature list, you can probably imagine Taskbuilder is the most advanced and powerful task & project management plugin in the market. Give Taskbuilder a try.

🚀 Why Choose Taskbuilder?
* Built for WordPress: Manage projects and tasks directly from your own WordPress website.
* Complete Project Workflow: Organize projects, create tasks, assign team members, and track completion.
* Visual Task Management: Use Kanban boards and task lists to manage work your way.
* Team-Focused: Give project members clear responsibilities and visibility into their work.
* Flexible Access: Manage project roles and permissions according to your team’s needs.
* Frontend & Backend Management: Let users work with projects and tasks through dedicated frontend pages using shortcodes.
* Extendable: Add more capabilities with Taskbuilder premium add-ons.
* Take control of your projects without moving your team’s workflow to another platform.

🔌 Extend Taskbuilder With Premium Add-ons :

Need more advanced project management capabilities? Extend Taskbuilder with premium add-ons.
* Calender – Get daily, weekly, or monthly view of task timelines with drag and drop feature. Filter them by Title,Project name, Status, Category, Priority,User Names if necessary.
* Email Piping – Email piping allows users to create tasks directly from their email inboxes. This will save a lot of time to visit your website every time, log in to their account, and then create a new task.
* Custom Fields – You can add Custom Field to the tasks and for projects. There are 5 types of custom fields you can create. i.e. Text, Number, Date, Dropdown, File Upload.
* Time Tracker – Time tracker tracks the exact time you spent on your tasks. Timer with start, stop feature for every task.
* Gantt Chart – Gantt Chart add-on effectively time manage your tasks and visualize upcoming deadlines for any project. Projects planners also use Gantt charts to maintain a bird’s eye view of projects.
* Duplicate Project – Duplicate Project add-on allows you to clone existing project and you will get same project with(tasks+checklists).
* Report – Report add-on allows you to create detail project progress reports for any project and customize which data should be shown in the report. You can then download report in PDF or CSV format.
* Buddypress – Buddypress Integration add-on allows you to create and manage projects,tasks in buddypress group on your own WordPress site.
* WooCommerce – WooCommerce Integration add-on automatically create task after order received. You can set order details in task description.
* Due Date Reminder – Due date reminder are super helpful for keeping your team on track to hit deadlines. Email notification will send to customer before due date of task.
* Usergroup – Using usergroup add-on you can assign group of users to project and those group assign to project can be assign to tasks of project.
* Recurrent Task – Recurrent Tasks add-on allow administrators to effortlessly schedule recurring tasks for routine tasks The system automatically generates these tasks at the defined times, providing a streamlined approach to essential and repetitive processes. With versatile recurrence periods, customizable scheduling options, and the ability to set start and end dates.
* Overdue Notifier – Overdue Notifier is a add-on that automatically sends email notifications when a task’s due date has passed and the task is not yet completed.
* SupportCandy– SupportCandy integration automatically creates a Taskbuilder task when a new SupportCandy ticket is created, and adds private notes to the ticket when the task is created and completed.
